description: Twelve labeled datasets from the frozen seed-42 90/10 holdout that are available on A1558. None belonged to the 179-volume training partition of EXP-017 or EXP-019.
limitations: Pilot subset: 12 of the original 20 holdout datasets.
The historical split is volume-random rather than embryo-group-disjoint.
Historical thresholds were selected using the same holdout family.
